title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Lemon Lime Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Lemon Lime Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit brings a punchy blend of citrus flavours with just the right amount of zest. Sharp Lemon leads with bright, tart freshness, while the Lime adds a slightly sweeter citrus lift for balance. The result is a crisp, clean vape that’s as vibrant as it is refreshing. Each pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and made exclusively for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The magnetic connection and twist-to-switch dual pod system make swapping flavours smooth and intuitive. With two pods in every pack, Lemon Lime offers a bright, palate-cleansing vape that works beautifully on its own or alongside fruit, mint, or beverage-inspired flavours.
